campaign.author: Pierre H. Vachon
campaign.description: You explore the Sword Lands in order to find who is behind trade caravan attacks. In doing so, you uncover a group of beings known only as the "Overlords", who are conspiring to conquer the Realmz!
campaign.name: Trouble in the Sword Lands
